outcome: Umbilical artery Doppler (pulsatility index and end-diastolic flow)
Pregnancy outcome (live birth, stillbirth or neonatal death)
finding: This Delphi study identified 16 essential and 30 recommended parameters that characterize FGR, including maternal characteristics, prenatal investigations, prenatal management, and pregnancy/neonatal outcomes, to improve data quality and consistency in FGR research.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as an essential parameter to be reported in all FGR studies.
